tutorials.title: Stella guide
tutorials.description: how to play Stella with Archipelago
tutorials.text:
# Stella setup

Archipelago support is built into Stella, so no mods are required.

# Archipelago setup

Download the apworld and yaml from the releases page. Place the apworld in your Archipelago/custom_worlds folder. Modify the yaml to your liking.

# Connecting

Select the archipelago option in the main menu to open the Archipelago Setup menu.
Enter your connection information and press connect
